description.description: These frames from the film Madagascar show penguins and chimpanzees being shipped to Africa in wooden crates. In the first and second frames, Kowalski and Skipper peek through holes in their crate, which is labeled with a shipping destination to a Kenyan wildlife preserve. The third frame focuses on a chimpanzee looking through the bars of its crate, labeled 'CHIMPANZEES'. The fourth frame shows Skipper looking back through the hole, and his flipper pointing at the shipping label.
